card.line: Pisgah is a mountain peak in Moab, east of the Jordan, where Balak built altars and where the LORD showed Moses the promised land.

moments.title: Balak's altars on Pisgah
moments.text: Balak took Balaam to the top of Pisgah and built seven altars, offering a bull and a ram on each. There the LORD met Balaam and put a message in his mouth, a blessing that could not be changed.

moments.title: Moses told to look
moments.text: The LORD told Moses to go to the top of Pisgah and see the land with his own eyes, because he would not cross the Jordan. Joshua would lead the people across.

moments.title: Moses sees the land
moments.text: Moses went up to the top of Pisgah, and the LORD showed him the whole land He had sworn to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Moses died there in Moab, as the LORD had said.
